en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a street parade featuring a marching brass band in traditional Balkan-style folk costumes (dark hats, vests, wide trousers and boots). The band is moving along a city street lined with multi‑story European-style buildings whose façades carry shop signs and banners. Spectators stand along the sidewalks and look from open windows above. A bannered group follows behind the band. The overall look suggests a festive civic or national celebration in an early–mid 20th century European town.
